search_text: published ZDI-21-248 ZDI-CAN-12216 (Pwn2Own) NETGEAR R7800 udchpd DHCP_REQUEST Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-02-24 CVE-2021-27252 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-27252 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['NETGEAR'] ['R7800'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R7800. title: (Pwn2Own) NETGEAR R7800 udchpd DHCP_REQUEST Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R7800. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the vendor_specific DHCP opcode. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
